start: Signed in as the owner; gym online with measurements switched on; member page of a member never measured

steps.action: Find the card "Body measurements"
user_sees: "No measurements yet"
"Measure <member name> at the desk: body weight, body fat and the tape measurements. Members see these in their MettleUp app (Progress → Body) after they check in at the gym once."
Button "Add measurements"

steps.action: Tap "Add measurements"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add measurements"
"<member name>. Fill in only what you measured."
Boxes "Day measured" (today), "Body weight (kg)", "Body fat (%)", the tape boxes under "Tape measurements (cm)", "Desk note (only your gym sees it)"
must_not: A day in the future already filled

steps.action: Type the weight and two tape sizes, tap "Save"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
Toast "Measurements saved. <member name> sees them in the MettleUp app."
The card lists today with "Measured by <name>" and each value

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member measured once before

steps.action: Tap "+ Add" at the top of the card
user_sees: Sheet "Add measurements" with "; last time was <day>" after the first line
must_not: The old values filled in as if measured today

steps.action: Save new values
user_sees: The new day on top
After each value the change in brackets
"Numbers in brackets show the change since the previous measurement."
must_not: A change worked out against the wrong entry
A change shown for a size measured only once

start: Signed in as the owner; "Add measurements" sheet open

steps.action: Tap "Save" with every box empty
user_sees: A red line saying nothing was filled in; the sheet stays open

steps.action: Type letters or a weight no person has, and a day in the future
user_sees: A red line under each wrong box
must_not: The wrong value saved and shown in the member app

steps.action: Look at the card in a gym that is not online
user_sees: "Measurements are kept on your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
No Add button

steps.action: Look at the card in a gym whose server does not have measurements yet
user_sees: "Measurements are not switched on for your gym yet."

start: Signed in as the owner; member page with five or more entries

steps.action: Tap "Show all <n>", then "Show fewer"
user_sees: All entries, then the newest four again

steps.action: Tap "Fix" on one entry, change the weight, tap "Save"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Fix measurements"
Toast "Measurements updated."
The changes in brackets worked out again
must_not: A second entry for the same day

steps.action: Tap "Fix", then "Delete"
user_sees: Sheet "Delete these measurements?"
"The measurements of <day> go from your list and from <member name>’s app the next time it checks the gym."
Buttons "Keep them" and "Delete"

steps.action: Tap "Delete"
user_sees: Button reads "Deleting…"
Toast "Measurements deleted."
The entry gone from the list
must_not: The entry still in the member app for good

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; an entry saved with a desk note

steps.action: Look at the entry here, then at the member's app (Progress → Body)
user_sees: Here: the values and "Desk note: <text>"
In the app: the values, marked with the gym's name
must_not: The desk note shown to the member ("only your gym sees it")
Weight the member logged privately on the phone shown here
